title: Finite cycle formula
statement: Let C be an abelian category and X a type-zero bigraded exact couple [def-sp-exact-couple]. Write T for its canonical cycle-boundary tower [def-sp-convergence]. For every natural t and integers p,q, T.Z t p q is the inverse image under X.f p q of the image of the incoming t-fold alpha iterate from D(p+2+t,q-1-t) to D(p+2,q-1). No cocone or tail assumption is required.

source.place: Lemma 12.21.4 (Tag 011T), cycle formula; Remark 12.21.5 (Tag 0AMJ), shifted form

proof.text: Use the recursively prescribed incoming powers A and mono inclusions I of pageCouple_image_prefix. Identify A with incomingAlphaIter by induction on their recurrences, with integer transports. Their image subobjects agree. Reuse the private incomingAlphaIter_succ helper of FinitePageImageLift for the incoming-iterate recurrence, via a proof-only import all.

Induct on r to show that the canonical cycle projection, page f and I r compose to the cycle inclusion followed by original f. The base is projection_zero. At the successor substitute projection_succ and the I recurrence, use DerivedMaps.f_comm, then cycleLift_comm, the induction hypothesis and the nested cycle inclusion equation.

Induct on r for the cycle formula with image I r. The base is the whole E and the pullback of the identity image. Rewrite the successor cycle recursion using ker(page d)=page f inverse image of ker(page g). Compose pullbacks. The commutative square in the previous step, whose right arrow I r is mono and whose left subobject is by induction the pullback of image I r, identifies this new cycle subobject with original f inverse image of the direct image under I r of ker(page g). Both square-factorization implications follow from the pullback universal property, cancelling the mono I r for the reverse implication. Exactness identifies ker(page g) with the incoming page-alpha image represented by derivedDInclusion. Its direct image under I r is the image of I(r+1), by the inclusion recurrence. Replace image I by image A and then A by incomingAlphaIter.

mathlib_searches.query: Finite page cycles of an exact couple are the inverse image under f of the image of an iterated alpha map

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCycle_formula (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (t : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) :
    X.cycleBoundaryTower.Z t p q =
      (Subobject.pullback (X.f p q)).obj
        (imageSubobject (X.incomingAlphaIter t (p + 2) (q - 1)))
